## Objective
- Build a complete, playable physical driving game based on the request “Зделай машину физическую” (“Make a physics car”).

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport width ≤1280px.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone Russian-language hill-driving game with canvas-rendered vehicle physics, terrain, collectibles, HUD, keyboard controls, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game in `index.html`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and browser rendering.
- Verified keyboard driving changes speed and distance, collects a bolt, and reset returns distance to zero.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/game-check.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Briefly report the implementation and note the assumption: a side-view hill-driving game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser test reached 95 km/h, 36 m, and 1 bolt; reset returned distance to 0.

content.text: Готово — в `index.html` создана полноценная игра про физическое вождение по холмам: машина подпрыгивает и наклоняется на неровностях, можно собирать болты и следить за скоростью и дистанцией. Управление — WASD или стрелки; на телефоне доступны экранные кнопки. Проверил заезд и сброс. Предположил, что вам подойдёт аркадный вид сбоку.
